description: X is reportedly exploring the use of stablecoins such as Circle’s USDC to pay royalties to influencers and content creators, according to CoinDesk. The discussions come as stablecoins gain traction for faster and cheaper cross-border payments. X recently replaced its Revenue Sharing model with the Original Content Rewards Program, while Elon Musk’s SpaceX is already using stablecoins for payments from some Starlink customers. The move could expand stablecoin use across creator payments and digital platforms.
title: Elon Musk’s X Considers Stablecoin-Based Payments for Influencers and Content Providers

description: Vivo V2607 has appeared on Geekbench with MediaTek's MT6881 chipset, which is believed to be the Dimensity 7500. The listing also points to 8GB of RAM and Android 16. Separately, the Vivo V2608A has surfaced in China's 3C database with a 90W charging adapter. The V2608A could be part of the upcoming X500 series, although its identity remains unclear. Vivo is also reportedly preparing the iQOO 16, which could launch in China with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro.
title: Vivo V2607 Geekbench Listing Reveals Key Details: What You Need to Know

description: Sony is overhauling its next live service bet, Horizon Hunters Gathering, after negative feedback from internal playtests. According to a new report, developer Guerrilla Games is rebooting the project and removing all live service elements from the game.
title: Sony's Live Service Co-Op Game Horizon Hunters Gathering Reportedly Being Rebooted After Poor Player Feedback

description: Lava Bold N4 Lite will be launched in India on August 27 at 12 pm IST, the Noida-based tech firm announced on Thursday. A dedicated microsite for the upcoming phone has also been made live on Amazon, confirming that it will be available for purchase in India via the e-commerce platform. The Noida-based smartphone maker claims that the Lava Bold N4 Lite will ship with an MIL-STD-810H military-grade rating for drop and shock protection. In terms of design, the Lava Bold N4 Lite is teased to sport a flat rear panel, with a square-shaped camera island placed in the top-left corner.
title: Lava Bold N4 Lite India Launch Date Announced; Design and Durability Details Teased

description: Qualcomm shared a video on X teasing the arrival of next-generation Snapdragon chipsets. The video confirms that the chipmaker will be revealing two chipsets at its Snapdragon Summit, which is set to take place next month. They are likely to be called Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro. These chips are likely to power the next wave of Android flagships.
title: Qualcomm Teases Two New Snapdragon 8 Elite Chips Ahead of Snapdragon Summit

description: OnePlus is planning to launch a new 4G smartphone in India in September, according to a tipster. The smartphone is said to debut exclusively in India, similar to the tech firm’s latest budget N series. Further, the leaker claims that the upcoming 4G handset could be the smartphone maker’s last product to launch in the country. If this is true, then the next OnePlus phone could be the tech firm’s first 4G handset to launch in India this year, since other offerings from the company ship with 5G and 4G LTE connectivity.
title: OnePlus Tipped to Launch a New 4G Phone Exclusively in India Next Month

description: The iQOO Buds is the latest addition to the Vivo sub-brand’s TWS lineup in India. Priced under Rs. 2,000, the iQOO Buds offers great value for its cost. While it lacks a few features, it makes up for them by delivering great audio quality for its price range. The long battery life also helps its case in many ways. However, the lack of wear detection does hinder daily use and the overall experience. Overall, it is a strong contender for people who value audio quality and have a tight budget.
title: iQOO Buds Review: Budget TWS With Not-So-Budget Sound

description: iQOO's rumoured compact gaming tablet could use Qualcomm's upcoming Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro, according to a new leak. The prototype is also said to include a high-powered fan for active cooling. The chipset could use a 2nm process and support LPDDR6 memory, while earlier reports have linked it to the iQOO 16. The tablet may arrive in the second half of 2026 and could compete with compact gaming models such as the Lenovo Legion Tab Gen 5.
title: iQOO Gaming Tablet Tipped to Get Active Cooling, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro SoC

description: Huawei Pura X View will go on sale in China on August 28. The company has opened pre-orders for the phone through its Vmall in China on Thursday. The listing shows the phone in Phantom Night Black, Leaping Shadow Red, Linen Grey and Zero Degree White shades (translated from Chinese). It measures 6.68mm in thickness and weighs 201g.
title: Huawei Pura X View Pre-Orders Begin; Confirmed to Feature Wide-Screen 16:9.5 Display, 7,000mAh Battery

description: BitGo has received virtual asset service provider registration in South Korea, allowing its local subsidiary, BitGo Korea, to offer crypto custody and transaction services to institutional and corporate clients. The company said it is the first global cryptocurrency firm to secure the registration in the country. BitGo Korea was established locally with security, anti-money laundering and compliance systems, while Hana Financial Group and SK Telecom are among its strategic investors.
title: BitGo Becomes First Global Crypto Firm to Secure South Korea VASP Licence

description: Chinese studio Game Science has released a new 15-minute gameplay trailer for the next Black Myth title, Black Myth: Zhong Kui. The extended trailer shares a first look at the game's combat and the protagonist. Game Science said the title was still in early development.
title: Black Myth: Zhong Kui Gets New 15-Minute Gameplay Trailer That Shares First Look at Combat

description: iQOO 16 and iQOO Neo 12 will be equipped with upgraded displays, a tipster claims. The flagship iQOO 16 is said to be equipped with a 6.85-inch display, offering 2K resolution and up to a 165Hz refresh rate. On the other hand, the iQOO Neo 12 will reportedly be launched with a 6.83-inch touchscreen, offering the same resolution as the iQOO 16, while delivering up to a 185HZ refresh rate. The Vivo sub-brand is said to source the AMOLED panel for the iQOO 16 from Samsung. Meanwhile, the Chinese display manufacturer Visionox is said to supply the display panel for the mid-range iQOO Neo 12. However, the company has yet to confirm these details.
title: iQOO 16, iQOO Neo 12 Tipped to Get Major Display Upgrades With Up to 185Hz Refresh Rate

description: Asus VM240 AiO has been launched in India with a 24-inch display. It runs on up to an AMD Ryzen 5 40 processor and features dual 2W Dirac-enhanced speakers. The Asus VM240 AiO was launched alongside the Asus Jelly 75 Keyboard KD201, Wireless Mouse MD105, Marshmallow Keyboard and Mouse Combo CW200 and ROG HDMI Cable LHR60.
title: Asus VM240 AiO All-in-One Desktop PC Launched in India With 24-Inch Display, New Gaming Accessories Tag Along

description: Moto G Max is now available for purchase in India. The handset was launched last week as the latest addition to the company's G-series lineup. It is the brand's second ‘Max' smartphone in the country, following the introduction of the Motorola Edge 70 Max last month. The Moto G Max sports a 6.72-inch full-HD+ LCD screen with a 120Hz refresh rate. It is powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 chipset and runs on Android 16. The handset packs a 7,000mAh battery with 30W wired charging support.
title: Moto G Max With Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 Chip, 7,000mAh Battery Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Vivo Y31T 5G price in India has been tipped online, suggesting that the upcoming handset will be a mid-range offering. This comes shortly after the phone was listed on the Vivo India online store. We already know that the Vivo Y31T 5G will be available for purchase in India via the Vivo online store in Crimson Red, Golden Mist, and Seashore colour options and 4GB + 128GB, 6GB + 128GB, and 6GB + 256GB RAM and storage configurations. The phone will ship with Vivo's Android 16-based OriginOS 6.
title: Vivo Y31T 5G Price in India Tipped Days After Firm Revealed Full Specifications List Ahead of Launch

description: Infinix Hot 70 Pro 5G is scheduled to launch in India in the first week of September. It is confirmed to be offered in Dive Blue, Mirage Green, Silk Glow Purple and Thermo Orange colours in the country. It will go on sale through Flipkart and the Infinix India website. It is already available in other global markets with a 6nm MediaTek Dimensity 7100 chipset. It has a 6.76-inch display.
title: Infinix Hot 70 Pro 5G India Launch Confirmed for September, Design and Colours Revealed

description: Google Photos is reportedly testing a map-based interface for Ask Photos that could organise search results by location. The feature was spotted in an unreleased app version and may show groups of photos as numbered clusters across a map. Users could zoom into areas and open individual clusters to see related images. Google already provides a separate map view through Collections, while Apple's Photos app has a similar feature. The new implementation would instead integrate location browsing directly with Ask Photos searches.
title: Google Photos Could Soon Add a Map View to Ask Photos Search Results, Feature Spotted in APK Teardown

description: Coinbase has received Financial Services Permission from Abu Dhabi Global Market’s Financial Services Regulatory Authority to provide investment intermediary and custody services for its planned tokenised securities platform. The approval brings the exchange’s offering under ADGM’s regulated financial services framework. Coinbase plans to use blockchain technology to issue traditional assets, with securities backed by underlying assets and subject to FSRA oversight. The move also builds on Coinbase’s earlier tokenisation initiative, Project Diamond, in Abu Dhabi.
title: Coinbase Expands Tokenisation Push With Abu Dhabi Regulatory Approval

description: The iQOO TWS 5e is priced at CNY 149 (roughly Rs. 1,800) in China and comes with 11mm high-resolution sound units. The earbuds support AAC, SBC and LC3 codecs, 35dB active noise cancellation and spatial audio. They also offer Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity with dual-device pairing and support wear detection. Battery life reaches up to 11.5 hours per earbud, while the charging case takes total playback to 50 hours with ANC disabled. The earbuds also carry an IP54 rating and support BlueOS ecosystem features.
title: iQOO TWS 5e Launched With 35dB ANC, Up to 50 Hours of Battery Life: Price, Features

description: The iQOO Z11 is a capable all-rounder that shares much of its DNA with the Vivo S2. However, it edges ahead in a few important areas. Its display is excellent for media consumption, performance is smooth for everyday use, and battery optimisation is noticeably better. The plastic rear doesn't feel particularly premium, and charging is only adequate. Still, if the two sibling phones are similarly priced, I would choose the iQOO Z11.
title: iQOO Z11 Review: A Capable All-Rounder for the Price

description: Google is reportedly preparing to showcase its first Googlebook laptops at a media event in New York City on September 15. The company could also reveal the official name of the operating system currently known as Aluminium OS. The Android-based platform is expected to combine features associated with ChromeOS and Android. Acer, ASUS, Dell, HP and Lenovo are among the reported launch partners. The event may also provide journalists with early access to the hardware, including opportunities to photograph, record and benchmark the devices.
title: Google Reportedly Plans Googlebook Hardware Preview for September 15

description: Google is rolling out a new visual indicator for its paid Android and web users. They are seeing a blue gradient ring in their account profile picture. This blue halo replaces the previously available multicoloured ring. The latest blue gradient ring resembles Gemini's icon. Select users can access the new design now.
title: Google Brings New Account Photo Design to AI and Google One Subscribers

description: Apple is expected to unveil its iPhone 18 series at its annual September launch event. The company's purported 2026 lineup could include the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and the long-rumoured iPhone Ultra, while the vanilla iPhone 18 is slated for an early 2027 launch alongside the iPhone 18e. While the Cupertino-based tech giant has yet to announce the event, leaks have given us an idea of when the event might take place. Based on the trend of yesteryears, we can deduce when Apple will announce the iPhone 18 launch event.
title: iPhone 18 Series Launch Countdown Begins: This Is When Apple Can Announce September Event

description: Anthropic has added new abilities and features for the Google Workspace connectors for Claude. The tech firm said that Claude can now send emails in Gmail and manage files in Google Drive. Further, with the Google Workspace connectors, the AI agent can reply to email threads, after drafting the email and sending after your approval. The company has also updated it support page to provide more details on the added capabilities. Anthropic says that Claude will ask for approval each time before taking any action, including sending, replying to, and forwarding emails, on a user’s behalf. Similarly, organisations on Team and Enterprise plans will have the ability to allow aforementioned actions to get executed without prior approval each time.
title: Claude Can Now Take Greater Control Over Gmail, Google Drive With Updated Google Workspace Connectors

description: iQOO Z11 was launched in India on Thursday as the latest addition to the company's Z series. The handset is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7500 Turbo chipset, coupled with up to 12GB of RAM. It sports a 6.83-inch 1.5K curved AMOLED screen with a 144Hz refresh rate. For optics, it has a 50-megapixel primary camera alongside an 8-megapixel ultra-wide-angle shooter. The iQOO Z11 packs a 7,050mAh battery with support for 44W FlashCharge.
title: iQOO Z11 Launched in India With Dimensity 7500 Turbo Chip, 7,050mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: GTA 6 leaks have continued into their second day, with more alleged gameplay footage from the title making the rounds of the internet on Thursday. The two new leaked gameplay videos show Jason, one of GTA 6's two protagonists, engaged in criminal activities. The leaker has threatened to release more videos from the game.
title: New GTA 6 Gameplay Leaks Emerge as Group Threatens to Release More Videos

description: Bitcoin moved sharply higher after US Treasury buybacks eased pressure on yields, while heavy short liquidations accelerated the move. Stronger ETF inflows and Ethereum’s gains also pointed to improving participation beyond Bitcoin.
title: Bitcoin Surges Towards $70,000 as Liquidity Boost and Short Squeeze Lift Crypto

description: CMF Buds Neo will be available in India from August 26 at an introductory price of Rs. 1,999. The earbuds feature 12.4mm dynamic drivers, up to 35dB Adaptive ANC and four HD microphones with Clear Voice Technology. They are claimed to offer up to 52 hours of playback with the charging case and support spatial audio, customisable EQ and 120ms low-latency gaming. Connectivity features include Bluetooth 6.0, dual-device pairing, Google Fast Pair and Microsoft Swift Pair.
title: CMF Buds Neo With 35dB ANC, Up to 52 Hour of Battery Launched in India: Price, Features

description: iQOO Buds has been launched in India as the company's new budget TWS. The TWS features 10mm moving coil drivers. It ships with support for AAC and SBC codecs, along with DeepX 4.0 Sound Effects and Spatial Audio. The iQOO Buds offer a 20Hz to 20,000Hz frequency range. It also offers a dual microphone unit, with support for two-ear voice calls. The earbuds also feature AI call noise reduction. The earbuds of the iQOO Buds pack a 53mAh battery, while the charging case is backed by a 525mAh battery.
title: iQOO Buds Launched in India With Up to 50 Hours Battery Life, AI Call Noise Reduction: Price, Features

description: Cases designed for the iPhone 17 Pro are likely to be compatible with the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro. A case manufacturer has already listed a case for the iPhone 17 Pro online, stating that it is compatible with both the iPhone 17 Pro and the iPhone 18 Pro. This hints that the new model will offer little or no design changes compared to last year's iPhone 17 Pro. The iPhone 18 Pro is expected to be launched on September 8.
title: iPhone 18 Pro May Look Nearly Identical to iPhone 17 Pro, New Leak Claims

description: ONMO+ cloud gaming platform comes with its own controller, much like the now-defunct Google Stadia, that can be paired with Android and iOS devices, PC, Macs, and TVs. The idea is the same as other cloud gaming services: ONMO+ lets you play games directly from the cloud on a variety of devices without requiring high-end gaming hardware.
title: ONMO+ 'Smart Console' Review: A Console-Like Cloud Gaming Experience for Casuals

description: Apple has been widely rumoured to foray into the AI wearables segment, with camera-equipped AirPods believed to be its first product. A recent software leak appeared to show the rumoured earbuds and their Visual Intelligence capabilities in action. This fuelled speculation about an imminent launch. However, a seasoned journalist claims that the Cupertino-based tech giant continues to face product development challenges, and a launch for 2027 still remains on track.
title: Apple’s Camera-Equipped AirPods Reportedly Still on Track for 2027 Launch Despite Recent Video Leak

description: Samsung on Wednesday announced a new Galaxy event for August. It will be the South Korean tech conglomerate’s third hardware launch event of the year, following the February and July showcases, where we saw the debut of the Galaxy S26 series and the new-generation Galaxy Z foldables, respectively. The company, however, remains cryptic about what could be introduced, with Samsung teasing the impending arrival of the ‘newest addition to the Galaxy S26 family’. This is likely a reference to the Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, which has been the subject of several leaks in recent months.
title: Samsung Announces Galaxy Event for August 27 to Introduce ‘Newest Addition’ to Galaxy S26 Family
